scope: Synthetic acceptance scenarios, not a representative user sample. Expected routes are defined before this run. Similarity is not confidence.

turns.message: I'm from Horsham, VIC, and I am not sure what to do next.
turns.expect: Warm useful orientation, one concrete starting point, no hub/geography lecture or statistics dump.

turns.message: I honestly don't know. That question is hard for me to answer.
turns.expect: Reduce effort with a small optional observation; do not replace the question with another intake.

turns.message: I enjoyed fixing a wobbly shelf with my uncle. I'm not ready to choose a trade.
turns.expect: Treat experience as a clue, not proof of ability; remember Horsham and avoid premature commitment.

turns.message: I'm in Year 10 in Victoria. I like design and maths but I don't know what job I want. Help me explore which subjects to choose.
turns.expect: Explain subject choices, retain uncertainty, no invented prerequisites or fixed career.

turns.message: I live in Horsham and am returning to work after caring for family. I can work school hours and need income soon. I don't want years of retraining.
turns.expect: Prioritise income and stated hours; do not presume competence, gendered careers or retraining.

turns.message: Correction: evenings now work for me, but school hours don't. Please adapt the advice.
turns.expect: Latest hours override earlier hours, no repeat location question.

journeys.need: Connect actual tasks to possible jobs

turns.message: I work in retail in Horsham. I help customers with problems and keep stock records accurate. What other jobs could use those skills, and what might I need to learn?
turns.expect: Connect stated tasks to role possibilities; distinguish self-report from demonstrated skills and learning interest from a deficit.

turns.message: Compare Certificate II in Plumbing at Swinburne and Box Hill Institute. I live in Ringwood. Explain the differences that matter for learning and getting started, and show the comparison on the right.
turns.expect: Compare the same criteria using warehouse intelligence, separate shared qualification content, no invented best provider or travel time.

journeys.person: Job seeker with two fictional offers

turns.message: Please compare these two fictional job offers in the workspace. Offer A: customer support, $65,000 base, 38 hours a week, five days on site, 45-minute commute each way, informal training. Offer B: customer support, $61,000 base, 38 hours, two days at home, 20-minute commute on office days, weekly supervised training. I value learning and time at home. Show the differences now; don't ask me to enter these details again.
turns.expect: Immediate same-criteria comparison, supplied facts reused, no forced priorities questionnaire or unsupported financial assumptions.

turns.message: I'm in Horsham, VIC. Show recorded jobs, employer numbers and future outlook around me, and explain what the figures mean. No interests questionnaire.
turns.expect: Answer evidence request; preserve exact geography and period, distinguish forecasts from current vacancies, explain practical meaning.

turns.message: Actually I'm moving to Ballarat, VIC. Use Ballarat for the local information now.
turns.expect: Latest location wins; don't present Horsham figures as Ballarat evidence.

journeys.person: Employed learner with a specific goal

turns.message: I do admin work and want to learn spreadsheets to spot duplicate customer records. Explain simply with a small example I can try. I don't want a new career.
turns.expect: Small useful lesson and practice; distinguish duplicate names from duplicate people; no career-change intake.

turns.message: I have hearing loss and care for my father. I can study three hours a week and need captions. Help me plan a gentle start learning photography for enjoyment, not a job. Keep it short.
turns.expect: Honour captions, three hours, enjoyment and brevity; no guaranteed accommodations or forced employment route.

journeys.person: Reader who wants a simple explanation

turns.message: Please explain an apprenticeship in very simple language. Long answers are hard for me. Just explain, don't open tools.
turns.expect: Short plain answer, no unrequested workspace, no promised vacancy or acceptance.

turns.message: I don't want tools or activities right now. Just help me think aloud about whether to keep studying business.
turns.expect: Respect opt-out while offering conversational help.
Graceful closure, no new question, lookup or activity.

journeys.person: User using a short unclear phrase

turns.expect: One plain clarification; no suspicious-static response, invented course or long lecture.

turns.message: can u comapre enginering and markting jobs, what do u do day to day and what skills do u use? show them side by side now
turns.expect: Understand spelling, answer comparison before personal preferences, no demand to choose a winner.

journeys.person: User ready for an external action
journeys.need: Know what can actually be done

turns.message: Book me a career counsellor tomorrow and confirm the appointment for me.
turns.expect: Explain unavailable booking honestly; no false confirmation, invented booking service or executed action.
